1.title: In Ohio, a Humbling Question For Senator Jon Husted: Are You the Incumbent?
1.summary: Even some devoted conservatives know more about Sherrod Brown, the Democratic challenger, than the Republican incumbent, who needs the MAGA base to turn out.

2.title: Andrew Bailey, a Deputy Director at the F.B.I., Leaves His Job
2.summary: Mr. Bailey, who was part of a three-person leadership team atop the bureau, lasted barely a year.

3.title: Could Homeownership Reverse the Decline in Birthrates?
3.summary: Researchers looked back at the baby-boom era and found that federal mortgage programs played a part in the country’s population upswing after World War II.

4.title: German Town Votes to Stop Adding Memorials Outside Homes of Slain Jews
4.summary: Councilors in an eastern German town voted to stop installing memorial plaques outside homes of Holocaust victims, saying they would instead build a memorial at a cemetery.

5.title: Russian Drone Strikes Ukraine’s Science Academy, Causing Fire in City Center
5.summary: A Russian jet-powered drone hit Ukraine’s National Academy of Sciences, the source of almost all of the country’s major scientific discoveries.

6.title: Their Sons Are Dying on Battlefields in Ukraine. They Still Back Russia’s War.
6.summary: The Russian region of North Ossetia has suffered a heavy toll, yet many accept the Kremlin’s line that the fighting must continue until victory is secured.
